# Today-pane text and file drop assertions do not cover the attachment URL fetch route

The checked tests provide plain-text ICS or an external File, while the mail-attachment URL handler performs fetch before parsing. The file test directly calls onExternalDrop to work around fabricated item counts. Their eight title/date/description assertions have no explanatory messages, an inherited test-quality gap. These source assertions neither exercise the URL connection policy nor establish a passing drop/import result. No test ran.

Scope: Calendar drop test proof limits.
